# Augur

> In-app feedback for React and TypeScript apps. Augur asks one well-timed question after a person finishes something ("Was it easy to export that report?"), takes Yes / Not really / Not sure and an optional line, then gets out of the way. A Feedback button opens a category panel (broke / confusing / missing) that sends the note with diagnostic context. It also counts repeated clicks on elements you label, to show where people get stuck. MIT licensed, no runtime dependencies.

Augur is distributed by copying the `augur/` folder into an app (or installing it with the shadcn CLI), not as an npm package. Data goes through one store: `SupabaseStore` (run `sql/schema.sql` once), `HttpStore` (your own API), or `LocalStore` (demo only). A custom store implements the `AugurStore` interface; its writes must reject on failure, because Augur only says "Thanks" once a note is stored.

Coding agents adding Augur should read AGENTS.md first and follow it: audit the app, propose where Augur asks (one to three moments right after a completed action, with a question that names the action and has Yes as the good answer), and get the developer's yes before writing code.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kaezee/Augur/main/AGENTS.md): the install and operating guide for coding agents
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kaezee/Augur/main/README.md): what Augur does, configuration, privacy, upgrading
- [Example](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kaezee/Augur/main/example/usage.tsx): a complete host integration in one file
- [Supabase schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kaezee/Augur/main/sql/schema.sql): tables and functions for SupabaseStore

## Install

- [shadcn registry item](https://kaezee.github.io/Augur/r/augur.json): `npx shadcn@latest add https://kaezee.github.io/Augur/r/augur.json`
- [Repository](https://github.com/kaezee/Augur): or copy the `augur/` folder by hand

## Optional

- [Live demo](https://kaezee.github.io/Augur/): Augur running inside a sample task board

- [DECISIONS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kaezee/Augur/main/DECISIONS.md): what Augur deliberately doesn't do, and why
